exposure: Healthy Families Healthy Futures (HFHF) enhanced with Steps to Success (STS) home visiting program
outcome: exposure to information related to program content (parenting and birth control)
cohort: The study included 248 young mothers, primarily teen parents in Houston, recruited through local health clinics and schools.
finding: The HFHF enhanced with STS program significantly impacted exposure to information on parenting and birth control, with an 85% chance of a favorable effect on these outcomes.
